senses.gloss:
Goḍīgīta
Jain. stotra. in 11 verses (Beg. jayati jagati candraH). Eulogy of Lord Pārśva of Goḍī. by Kalyāṇasāgarasūri. BORI. 1406 (8) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIX. i. 132.
Pt.. in Prakaraṇaratnākara Vol. II. p.. 102-03, 1876.

Goḍīgīta
Jain. in 17 verses. (Beg. goDIpuraprabhupArzvamamaMdaM). song in honour of Lord Pārśva in the city of Goḍī. by Kalyāṇasāgarasūri. BORI. 1406 (11) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIX. i. 133.
Pt.. in Prakaraṇaratnākara Vol. II. p. 105. 1876.

Goḍīpārśvanāthastuti
or pArzvadevastava Jain. in 6 verses. BORI. 1293 (b) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIX. i. 325.
See under Pārśvadevastava also

Goḍīpārśvastotra
Jain. in 108 kārikās; by Yaśovijaya. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 106. 276. [Page117-a.

Goḍīpārśvāṣṭaka
Jain. (Beg. vAmeyaM marudezabhUSaNataraM) in 11 verses. by Kalyāṇasāgarasūri. BORI. 1406 (7) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIX. i. 135.
Pt.. Prakaraṇaratnākara Vol. II. p.. 101-102.

Goḍu
Jain. name by which Āryarakṣita was called by his father.
See NCC. II. p. 173a.
